title: How to Add Driver's License to Apple Wallet in 2026
summary: Learn how to add your driver's license to Apple Wallet and where you can use digital ID at airports and businesses. Complete setup guide for 2026.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Apple Wallet supports digital driver's licenses in select U.S. states, requiring approval from the issuing authority before activation.
- Digital IDs work at TSA checkpoints in participating airports and select businesses that accept contactless identification verification.
- Setup requires iOS 15.4 or later, Face ID or Touch ID authentication, and scanning both sides of your physical license.


Apple Wallet's digital ID feature lets iPhone users store state-issued driver's licenses and identification cards directly on their devices. Officially launched on November 1, 2026, the feature streamlines identity verification at airports, retail locations, and other participating venues. The system requires approval from your state's issuing authority and works through encrypted, contactless communication between your iPhone and verification terminals.


## Eligibility and Requirements


Before adding your driver's license to Apple Wallet, verify that your state participates in the program. As of late 2026, participating states include Arizona, Colorado, Georgia, Maryland, and several others, with additional states rolling out support throughout the year. Your iPhone must run iOS 15.4 or later, and you'll need Face ID or Touch ID enabled for secure authentication.


The digital ID feature only works with valid, unexpired physical licenses issued by participating state authorities. International driver's licenses and permits from non-participating states cannot be added to Apple Wallet at this time. Your iPhone must also be updated to the latest iOS version to ensure compatibility with verification systems.


## Step-by-Step Setup Process


Open the Wallet app on your iPhone and tap the plus icon in the upper right corner. Select "Driver's License or State ID" from the list of available card types. You'll be prompted to position your physical license within the camera frame, capturing both the front and back. The system will extract information from the card's barcode and magnetic stripe data.


Next, complete a selfie verification process by positioning your face within the on-screen frame and following the movement prompts. This biometric check matches your live image to the photo on your physical license. Finally, review the extracted information for accuracy and submit your application to your state's issuing authority. Approval typically takes 24 to 72 hours, though processing times vary by state.


## Where You Can Use Digital ID


TSA security checkpoints at participating airports represent the primary use case for Apple Wallet digital IDs. As of 2026, more than 25 major U.S. airports support contactless ID verification through dedicated TSA PreCheck lanes. Simply hold your iPhone near the verification terminal and authenticate with Face ID or Touch ID to complete the identity check.


Select businesses and venues also accept Apple Wallet IDs for age verification and identity confirmation. Participating retailers include certain pharmacy chains, automotive rental agencies, and hospitality providers. The list of accepting merchants continues to expand as more businesses install compatible verification hardware.


- TSA security checkpoints at 25+ U.S. airports
- Select pharmacy locations for prescription pickup
- Participating car rental agencies
- Hotels and hospitality providers with digital check-in
- Age-restricted retail purchases at compatible terminals


## Privacy and Security Features


Apple Wallet digital IDs use end-to-end encryption to protect your personal information during verification transactions. When you present your digital ID, only the specific data required for that transaction is shared. For example, age verification at a retail location only transmits confirmation that you meet the minimum age requirement, not your birth date or full address.


The system never stores ID presentation history on Apple's servers or shares transaction data with third parties. Your digital ID remains locked behind biometric authentication, preventing unauthorized access even if your iPhone is lost or stolen. Remote device wipe capabilities through Find My iPhone provide an additional security layer.


## What This Means


Digital driver's licenses in Apple Wallet represent a significant step toward contactless identity verification, reducing reliance on physical cards for routine transactions. The feature streamlines airport security, retail age checks, and identity confirmation while maintaining strong privacy protections. As more states adopt the technology and businesses install compatible verification systems, digital IDs will become increasingly practical for everyday use. The combination of biometric authentication, encrypted data transmission, and selective information sharing establishes a security model that may set standards for future digital credential systems.
